title: Widgets for the Nano ecosystem
sub: Tiny live instruments for any website: prices, market cap, network telemetry, calculators. Embed with one line of code.
embedHint: Paste this snippet anywhere HTML is accepted: a centered card, at most 400px wide and never wider than the screen. The widget follows your visitors' theme automatically.
descPrice: Live XNO price with 1H / 24H / 7D deltas, market cap and supply.
descMarketCap: Nano market cap, rank and daily change. Plus a 'what if Nano had Bitcoin's cap' mode.
descCalculator: XNO to fiat converter, preloaded with the live price.
descNetwork: Block count, cemented ratio, online weight and principal representatives.
descAccount: Balance card for any Nano address. Public ledger data only.
descLive: A live stream of confirmed Nano transactions.
descDonate: QR donation card with preset amounts and deep links.
policy: Works anywhere HTML is accepted: websites, blogs, wikis, dashboards. Live data, cached for every visitor.
donateTrust: Address provided by the site owner
addressHint: Public ledger address to display. Any nano_ address
